title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Pallavan surprises his brothers by securing the top rank in college and invites them onto the stage. The family joyfully celebrates his success, leaving Chandayatha alone.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
episodeTitle: Malar Dreams of Going to Work
description: Malar shares her wish to work with Bagyaraj, imagining herself as an independent woman. Then, Lakshmi and Malar cleverly trick Ragavan and head out for the secret movie outing.

title: Bigg Boss
episodeTitle: BBTam Day 71: Ticket to Finale Battle Begins
description: A fierce captaincy race crowns a new face, dividing the house. Paper shredder nominations heat up as Bigg Boss announces the high-stakes ticket to finale build-up week.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Sethupathi breaks down, regretting that he failed to trust Tamizhselvi and caused her pain. Malar's revelation about Aishwarya's deception leaves Tamizhselvi's family shocked.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Saranya's devoted care during his fever makes Karikalan feel remorse for overlooking her. Kamala uncovers Aadhavan's love for Pooja by enquiring with her house owner.

title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Kanmani's clear business plan and bold response impress the investors, earning her a huge investment. As everyone celebrates her success, Rajeshwari and Vennila grow furious.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Kandhasamy informs Abhi's parents about his decision to celebrate the reception grandly. Later, Abhi firmly rejects Murugan's offer to take up the catering order for the event.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Palanivel gets emotional while holding his newborn child and seeing Suganya. Muthuvel tries to convince Sakthivel to end the family feud by apologising to Gomathi.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Shruthi informs the family of her decision to repay her parents. Meanwhile, Vijaya takes credit for the Gulkand idea, and Muthu spots Arun learning karate.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Moved by Abinaya's care, Vetri pleads with her for forgiveness and a reunion. After witnessing his roadside confrontation with a woman, Sandhya issues a stern warning.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Poongodi and Thenmozhi visit the farm to check Azhagar's sincerity. Finding him working responsibly, Poongodi accepts defeat in her challenge with Thenmozhi.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Ilamathi prevents Paraman from signing the well-desilting contract with Pasupathy, citing his poor work. Later, Pasupathy pressures Kalamma to return his bribe money.
